name: pflow
description: Petri net simulation and analysis MCP server. petri_* tools build, simulate, verify and analyze models; pflow_* tools are pflow-rs-only extras. Every tool accepts DSL S-expression text, tokenmodel Schema JSON, pflow.xyz Shape A JSON, or Shape B Model JSON.

tools.name: pflow_build
tools.description: Parse a Petri net model and return its topology: places, transitions, arcs, and initial state

tools.name: petri_validate
tools.description: Validate a Petri net model (DSL or JSON), return structure summary and content-addressed ID (CID)

tools.name: pflow_fire
tools.description: Fire discrete transitions step-by-step on a Petri net. Returns token state after each step and which transitions are enabled

tools.name: petri_simulate
tools.description: Run ODE simulation of a Petri net over time. Returns downsampled time series for all places

tools.name: pflow_equilibrium
tools.description: Find the equilibrium (steady state) of a Petri net ODE system. Reports whether equilibrium was reached and the final state

tools.name: petri_stochastic
tools.description: Run the portable Gillespie SSA (seeded, byte-exact across go-pflow/pflow-rs/pflow-xyz/pflow-jl). Returns the ensemble mean and stddev per place on a fixed time grid

tools.name: petri_analyze
tools.description: Analyze Petri net structure: incidence matrix (input/output/delta per transition), enabled transitions at initial marking

tools.name: petri_verify
tools.description: Check declarative properties (deadlock-free, bounded, live, terminating, conserves, reachable, unreachable, mutual exclusion, linear invariants). Returns proved/refuted/unknown per property with the proof method and a replayable counterexample on refutation

tools.name: petri_invariants
tools.description: Compute minimal-support P-invariants and T-invariants, plus whether every place is covered by some invariant (sufficient for structural boundedness)

tools.name: petri_conformance
tools.description: Replay an event log against a model: fitness, precision, F-score, and per-trace diagnostics

tools.name: petri_scenario
tools.description: What-if: override the initial marking, rates, or a rate schedule (or compare named scenarios) and run the model's own stochastic engine

tools.name: petri_extend
tools.description: Apply structural operations (add/remove place, transition, arc, event, event field, binding) to a model. Returns the modified model and which operations applied or failed

tools.name: petri_diff
tools.description: Compare two models and show structural differences: added/removed places, transitions, and arcs

tools.name: petri_canonical
tools.description: Content-addressed identifier for a model: the ecosystem URDNA2015 + CIDv1 when the input is JSON-LD-shaped (Shape A), otherwise a labelled pflow-rs identity hash

tools.name: petri_lumping
tools.description: Check ordinary lumpability of the CTMC a model's stochastic engine samples: the coarsest partition of the reachable state space that is itself an exact-answer CTMC (bounded by max_states)

tools.name: petri_dataset
tools.description: Generate a synthetic event log (CSV: case_id,activity,timestamp) from a seeded stochastic playout of the model
